Lzahlia's [[55]] "Philosphy of Systems", "Systems Theory" or simply "Framework of Systems" is a Philosophical [[48]] Framework [[29]] for understanding how General Systems [[38]] are governed by Observable Laws [[]]. These laws are integral to the Framework, as they imply an inherent "Order to the Universe [[110]]."

This is the "Logos" [[9]]

At basis, this Philosophy begins by mapping "the four fundamental domains of Systems" [[28]]. This provides a fertile structure for understanding the applicability of these Highly Complex, Abstract [[106]] ideas.
